title: Do not care for this frame , but Daughter does!.
text:
Do not care for this frame , but Daughter does!.. This is strong.
We are not heavy people...155 lbs, and 135 lbs.

I do not like the looks of our Dux mattress on this, And its not tall enough!
That said, my daughter loves this frame.
